messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency > SLO (streaming) for service=redwood-inference/runtime in eu-west-1. Current p99=2.8s (SLO=1.5s). p95=1.2s. Elevated error rate on streaming endpoints. Incident priority: P1. Thread opened for live mitigation.
oncall-anna: Oncall here, acknowledging. I'm pulling up the dashboards now. Any recent deploys or config changes?
eng-sre-jay: saw a postfix deploy ~45m ago that included prefix-hash v3 rollout. Rolling diff: prefix hash code + namespace sharding tweak. I'm looking at cache hit-rate graphs.
infra-miguel: confirmed spike in cache misses starting 00:34UTC (approx 40m ago). Hit-rate for prefix-cache (all live namespaces) dropped from ~97.9% -> 56.8%. Sample metrics: 
```
prefix_cache_hits_total: 8.2e6
prefix_cache_misses_total: 6.5e6
miss_rate_window_1m: 43.2%
```
We also see increased KV read latency and downstream backpressure.
alice-ml: streaming stall traces show frequent blocking on get_prefix_kv() with tail latencies for those calls rising to 200-500ms. When KV misses happen, runtime stalls until fetch completes and KV gets populated.
pm-kendra: Customer impact: support reports 3 customers with streaming timeouts and degraded UX on chat flows. No billing or data loss. Severity: user-visible latency.
customer-ops-sam: I've opened CS tickets and attached sample request IDs from customer A (req: 9b3f...). They're seeing streaming gaps and reconnects. I'll escalate to enterprise CS as well.
eng-sre-jay: hypothesis: prefix-hash v3 changed salt/namespace mapping such that previously-warm cache keys are now cold -> mass misses. Combined with our cache TTL of 12h and eviction pressure, this looks like a rollout-induced coldwave.
oncall-anna: Ok, immediate mitigation options? Can we rollback the prefix-hash rollout or enable compatibility mode?
eng-sre-jay: We have a runtime feature-flag gate: `prefix_hash_version`. Options: roll forward to fix (unlikely quick), rollback to v2 (fast), or enable `compat-read` where runtime checks both v2 and v3 keys on miss (slower but safe).
infra-miguel: Rollback path: we can flip flag via ops-config and restart small pool. Command to flip: 
```
# flip prefix hash back to v2
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/flags -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" 
  -d '{"prefix_hash_version":"v2","reason":"live mitigation - revert v3 rollout"}'
```
This will take ~6-10 minutes to propagate and needs a rolling restart on serving nodes.
eng-sre-jay: Compatibility read impl is behind a flag `prefetch_compat` but it's not stress-tested at scale. It would increase read latency but avoid wholesale misses. Tradeoff: higher p50/p95 for a bit vs large cold misses.
alice-ml: If we do rollback, we should trigger a targeted warmup: prefetch top prefixes for heavy customers. I can provide a quick warmup list (top 5000 prefixes).
pm-kendra: please do warmup if rollback selected. Customers want minimal downtime.
oncall-anna: OK decision: rollback prefix_hash -> v2 and start warmup for top prefixes. Start throttling non-critical background jobs to reduce eviction pressure. Please post commands and progress.
deploy-bot: Deploy request accepted: revert-feature(prefix_hash_version=v2) started by oncall-anna. Canary rollout to 10% of capacity.
eng-sre-jay: starting rollback command now. Canary to 10% in eu-west-1 first. Will monitor hit-rate and stream latency.
infra-miguel: throttling background prefetch and batch recompute on infra side. Running: `systemctl stop prefetcher.service` on non-critical pools.
alice-ml: kicking off warmup script against canary nodes: 
```
python tools/warmup_prefix_cache.py --list warmup_top5000.txt --parallel 40 --target canary-eu-west
```
Expect ~8-12 minutes for warmup to materially reduce miss rate on canary.
eng-sre-jay: canary metrics: after toggling to v2 on 10% nodes we see canary miss-rate drop to 6% within 9m. Streaming p99 on canary back to 1.3s. Production-wide still elevated.
oncall-anna: good sign. Proceed to roll forward rollback to 100% with rolling restarts. Coordinate safe windows and keep canary observation for 5 more minutes.
eng-sre-jay: rolling restart in progress. ETA ~12 minutes to full. I'm watching `prefix_cache_miss_rate` and `streaming_p99`.
customer-ops-sam: update to support: telling affected customers we have an ongoing mitigation (rollback) and expect latency to improve within 15-30m.
pm-kendra: please capture affected customer IDs and flag for prioritised warmup once rollback complete.
deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% begun. Progress: 30% -> 60% -> 90% 
deploy-bot: Rollout complete. All serving nodes now on prefix_hash_version=v2.
eng-sre-jay: post-rollback metrics: global prefix hit-rate: 94.7% (was 56.8%), streaming p99=1.35s, p95=0.98s. Error rate back to baseline.
oncall-anna: thanks team. Closing active mitigation. Follow-ups: postmortem owner?
eng-sre-jay: I'll own postmortem. Primary action items: (1) add rollout safety checks for prefix-hash migrations (simulate mapping delta), (2) add warmup step to rollout playbook, (3) improve canary read path to run compat-read for 10m before full cutover, (4) automated alerting for mass miss-rate delta.
alice-ml: I'll provide warmup tooling improvements and a precomputed top-prefix set for heavy customers.
infra-miguel: I'll add a flag to throttle evictions during rollouts and add a dashboard for eviction pressure.
pm-kendra: I'll coordinate customer comms and update CS templates.
oncall-anna: Oncall handoff: I'm handing to @eng-sre-jay for follow-up. Current state: stable, SLOs back within threshold, CS notified. Handoff ETA 06:00UTC.
eng-sre-jay: acknowledged handoff. Will take follow-ups and start postmortem doc. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
